pull_request.title: Add native per-account SQLite storage foundation
pull_request.body:
Native Desktop/Mobile clients previously had only placeholder directories. This adds a per-account SQLite storage foundation and two thin native Dart consumers. Local send, committed ACK, realtime and Sync writes converge transactionally on the same row, preserve terminal SENT, and update data plus cursors atomically. Private schema1 includes genuine initial migration, failure and future-version checks.

Desktop/Mobile jobs and their compatibility steps now execute native storage tests. Existing backend/contracts/security/ACK semantics remain unchanged. Full UI, network send/Sync orchestration, device acceptance and S2 Gate completion remain outside this first-task scope.

Fresh independent review rejected the first candidate: reused user event IDs could change state/cursor. A fresh Fix Agent added atomic typed event identity checking/persistence and nine regression tests that fail before the correction and pass afterward. Identical replay remains harmless; payload conflicts, reopen/two-connection reuse and rollback are covered. First FAIL evidence and its green CI are preserved; old CI does not accept the fix.

Current local validation: shared33 + Desktop1 + Mobile1 actual SQLite tests; strict analyze/format/locked dependencies; frozen/architecture34, source checks, CI29, WSS18 and Sync79 vectors pass. Four Windows symlink privilege subcases require Linux CI. NEW independent review and exact-head required hosted jobs for the fix candidate are pending. Implementation and first-review Recorder FAILs are disclosed/preserved; fresh Fix Recorder finished PASS with structural validation. No full Task/S2 acceptance claim yet.
